From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>

Anthony 
From: Bhatia, Peter <pbhatia@gannett.com>
Sent: Sunday, August 23, 2020 6:31 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Employee fiile 
 
I’ll pass on the request ... let’s talk again this week before your deadline.
On Aug 23, 2020, at 8:53 AM, Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:

Hope your weekend is going well. On Thursday, I sent a request to HR to obtain a copy of my employee file. I have followed up each of the past three days but my request remains "on hold," according to the application. If there is anything you can do to provide me with a timeline for this, let me know.

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
